posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations, together with its secretariat, has embarked on a journey to  Zambezi Region to assess compliance with labour standards in the retail and wholesale sectors.
The assessment forms part of the Committee’s oversight mandate over the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industrial Relations, including monitoring its operations and budget implementation
My key question is whether the Labour Department is adequately funded and resourced to conduct effective workplace inspections and ensure compliance with labour standards
Through hands-on oversight and engagement with workers, employers and relevant stakeholders, the Committee will gather evidence and assess the realities on the ground
